title: Tracker Status Frame
description: Health frame the Jetson tracker's WebSocket sends after `hello`, interleaved with needle frames (needle-simulator packages/needle-jetson/.../tracker/engine.py, _build_status_payload()). Consumer: apps/desktop/src/types.ts (StatusFrame); apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/ws_client.rs tags frames with `type` == `status` as health and forwards every other post-hello frame as needle data.
$comment: additionalProperties is true and MUST stay true, for the same reason as tracker/hello.json. The producer is the only status/needle discriminator the client has, so `type` must stay const 'status' here and absent from tracker/frame-needle.json.

health.description: `degraded` iff `issues` is non-empty. The desktop's type also admits `error`; the producer never sends it.

issues.description: Active problems. camera_*_missing come from capture health via the calibrated face-to-slot map; markers_invisible only while CALIBRATING.

needle_present.description: Whether a needle is currently being tracked (TRACKING with an initialised tip filter, which includes the Kalman-prediction window). False = ready/background, which the desktop must not show as a stale link.
